liveComparisonBlocker: No NASA POWER series exists in the repo, offline or cached; OFFLINE_PROFILES are month x hour means and every offline run (including test fixtures) builds its series from them with synthesizeFromProfile. The issue's live-vs-fallback sizing comparison therefore has no second series to read.

darkMonthProbe.note: SENSITIVITY PROBE, not weather: the darkest mean month scaled to 70% GHI. Bounds what a darker-than-average real month would do to a tier100 battery.
